g.text: Google-Owned Track (TRUSTED | BLOCK) • 3rd-Party Track (BLOCK | SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA | LIMITED)

svg.text: TRACK 1 — GOOGLE-OWNED APPLICATIONS (ONLY TWO ADMIN CONSOLE CHOICES: TRUSTED OR BLOCKED)
BRANCH A — 3RD-PARTY "TRUSTED" POLICY GOVERNANCE & EXCEPTION LOGIC
BRANCH B — 3RD-PARTY "UNCONFIGURED" (SHADOW IT) SIFTING & POLICY ASSIGNMENT

g.text: First-party Google service (exempt from 3rd-party 6-month Trusted downgrade).
Google-owned apps only support TRUSTED or BLOCKED in Workspace API Controls.
Policy Target: TRUSTED (Standard recommendation for all Google-owned apps).
Policy already locked to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA, LIMITED, or BLOCKED.
Zero recommendations generated — counts toward 100% domain posture.
• Vendor Breach → Action: BLOCK immediately to sever active tokens.
• New Scope Added → Action: SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (or LIMITED) to stop scope creep.
Low/moderate scope sensitivity with no breach or new scope expansion.
Remains compliant; escalates to Tier 1 only if Gate T1 exception fires.
Assumed deliberately reviewed & approved by Administrator within last 6 months.
Monitored continuously for Gate T1 exceptions; next scheduled check at 180d.
High-risk Trusted app not reviewed in > 6 months (assumed forgotten by Admin).
1. Primary Action: Set to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA to lock current scopes & block escalation.
2. Or Re-Confirm Trusted on schedule to reset the 6-month (180-day) approval timer.
Unconfigured app with active vendor security breach. Block API access immediately.
Policy Target: BLOCKED (Revokes all OAuth scope access across domain).
High/Critical scopes (Drive, Gmail, Admin) without Google verification or active
multi-user business adoption → Policy Target: BLOCKED.
Google-verified app actively used (≤ 30d) across multiple users.
Policy Target: SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA (Approves current scopes; blocks escalation).
• Verified + Active (≤ 30d): Set to SPECIFIC GOOGLE DATA to preserve Calendar/Sheets.
• Unverified or Dormant (> 30d): Set to LIMITED (allows SSO; blocks restricted scopes).
Apps using only basic identity/unrestricted scopes (openid, email, profile).
Policy Target: LIMITED (Preserves login; blocks restricted scopes automatically).
